en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet, tree‑lined residential street with large late‑19th‑century villas behind wrought‑iron fences. In the foreground is a circular fountain basin with water jet and several classical statues on brick pedestals surrounded by trimmed bushes. Gas‑style street lamps and a gently curving road are visible. On the distant hill, a tower‑like structure and a pavilion or small temple stand against the skyline. There is no visible printed text on the front.
